title: Birkenstock Rallies on Forecast; StubHub Falls on Earnings | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- StubHub (STUB) shares are dropping after the company reported earnings per share for the second quarter that missed the average analyst estimate. 
- Birkenstock (BIRK) is rallying after the footwear maker boosted its adjusted Ebitda forecast for the full year. The German company also reported better-than-expected sales for the second quarter. 
- Cerebras (CBRS) is lower after the company projected slower growth than some investors anticipated, causing its shares to fall in premarket trading. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Traders Pare Bets on Fed Rate Hike This Year as Oil Prices Fall
summary: Bond traders stopped fully pricing in a Federal Reserve interest-rate increase this year amid a retreat in oil prices that reinforced positive sentiment on the inflation outlook.

title: Stocks Set for Record Highs on Inflation Surprise: Markets Wrap

title: Airlines Reflect Our Economic Future

title: Old Mutual Shares Trade Again in Zimbabwe After Six-Year Halt
summary: Shares in Old Mutual Ltd. began trading on Zimbabwe’s dollar-denominated stock exchange, six years after they were suspended on the country’s main bourse to curb a currency rout.

title: Odd Lots: Trucking Is Booming and Drivers Aren’t Happy About It
summary:
In the last year, freight companies have seen a significant upturn in business. But in addition to growing demand, the industry has also experienced new constraints on the supply side, with the US administration cracking down on who is even allowed on the road.

Reed Loustalot, chief marketing officer at the Truck Parking Club, joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal on the Odd Lots podcast to discuss the booming trucking business and the crackdown on the supply side of the market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Foreign Investors Flee Brazil Stocks at Fastest Pace Since 2021
summary: Foreign investors pulled money out of Brazilian equities on Tuesday at the fastest pace in over five years as concerns over the presidential election make them increasingly wary of the outlook for the fiscal deficit and the economy.

title: Colombia alista emergencia económica tras terremoto

title: Rate-Hike Bets Ease; Anthropic in Talks to Buy Decart | Bloomberg Brief 08/13/2026
summary: US equity futures waver after a tech-led rally as an in-line CPI print eases wagers on a rate hike from the Fed. The US Treasury is set to auction $25 billion of 30-year notes after the 10-year debt sold at the highest yield since 2007. Anthropic is said to be in talks to acquire startup Decart AI for $6 billion. Priya Misra of JPMorgan Asset Management discusses the Fed’s rate path forward.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tech Drives Up Credit Risk for Safe Firms With No AI Links

title: Frasers Group Buys Harvey Nichols Out of Insolvency, Beating Next
summary: Mike Ashley’s Frasers Group Plc acquired struggling Harvey Nichols out of insolvency, beating out rival retailer Next Plc for the storied British department store chain after it fell on hard times.

title: Kaplan on Rate Hikes, Warsh at Jackson Hole
summary: Former Dallas Fed President and Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman Robert Kaplan says the Federal Reserve was right to hold rates in July. He also says Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh needs to give some more details about policy when he speaks in Jackson Hole. Kaplan speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jaguar Land Rover Sales Dented by Supplier Fire and Iran War
summary: Jaguar Land Rover Automotive Plc’s revenue tumbled almost 10% in the latest quarter after production at Britain’s largest carmaker was derailed again.

title: Air India Orders One-Off Drug Test for Its Over 5,000 Pilots
summary: Air India Group will screen its more than 5,000 pilots for psychoactive substances in an unprecedented one-time action, according to an internal email, after a captain allegedly tested positive for illegal drugs following the mid-air plunge of its Phuket-Delhi flight.
